summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Hapoel Rishon LeZion F.C., an Israeli football club. It states that the club currently plays in Liga Leumit, Israel's second football division, and hosts home matches at Haberfeld Stadium. It also records two name changes: a 1991 rename to Hapoel Ironi Rishon LeZion and a June 2008 switch back to the original name after a change in ownership.
one_line: Hapoel Rishon LeZion F.C. is an Israeli football club playing in Liga Leumit, with a history of name changes including 1991 and 2008.
key_facts: Hapoel Rishon LeZion F.C. is an Israeli football club.
Hapoel Rishon LeZion F.C. currently plays in Liga Leumit, Israel's second football division.
Home matches of Hapoel Rishon LeZion F.C. are hosted at the Haberfeld Stadium.
In 1991, Hapoel Rishon LeZion F.C. changed its name to Hapoel Ironi Rishon LeZion.
In June 2008, the name Hapoel Ironi Rishon LeZion was switched back to Hapoel Rishon LeZion.
The 2008 name switch back to Hapoel Rishon LeZion followed a change in ownership of the club.
